headline: NCT DREAM take 'Music Bank' win with 'Boogie Woogie'
caption:
NCT DREAM won first place on 'Music Bank' with 'Boogie Woogie'.

On the Nov 20 episode of KBS 'Music Bank', they beat ITZY's Chaeryeong ('Lovesick') with 7,239 points. It's the song's second music show trophy after 'Show Champion'. 'Boogie Woogie' is the title track of their 6th full album 'DREAM AFTER DREAM'.
